description: The hub's place pages, built from the platform's own data: 'areas' (1:250k map sheets), 'provinces' (geological provinces), 'commodities', 'mines' (Minedex mines and deposits). Without slug: the pages of that kind whose name matches q, with their report and Minedex counts. With slug: that page's figures (reports by decade, top commodities and operators, Minedex sites, training sites...) and its sources.

q.description: Part of a name or code (e.g. "kalgoorlie", "SH51-09", "gold").

slug.description: A page's slug from an earlier answer.

name: place_page
title: Get a place page
